arabic text: AB BHI AATI HAI SAKINA KI SADAIN LOGON\nHAYE ZINDAANO SAI
english translation text: THE VOICE OF SAKINA CAN STILL BE HEARD FROM THE PRISON OF SHAAM

arabic text: SISKIAN LAI KAI JO KEHTI THI MUSALMANO SAI\nMERAI BABA SAI MILA DO MAIN DUAIN DUN GI,
english translation text: SHE USED TO CRY AND ASK THE MUSLIMS, 'PLEASE TAKE ME TO MY FATHER, I WILL PRAY FOR YOU'

arabic text: BOLAI SAJJAD SAKINA YEH MUQADDAR TERA\nBAI QAFAN TUJ KO LIYAI PHIRTA HUN BAZARON MAIN\nAUR LAHU AJ BHI JAARI TERAI KAANO SAI
english translation text: IMAM SAJJAD SAID: 'THIS IS YOUR DESTINY O SAKINA, I AM CARRYING YOUR BODY AND UNABLE TO FIND A SHROUD FOR YOU,\nAND THE BLOOD IS STILL FLOWING FROM YOUR EARS'

arabic text: JA KAI MAQTAL MAIN PUKARI YEH SAKINA RO KER\nBAHIYA QASIM MERAI AKBER TUM KAHAN HO SARAI\nMERAI BABA KO BACHA LO AAKAI SHAITANON SAI
english translation text: SAKINA WENT TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD AND SAID CRYING, 'O BROTHER QASIM AND ALI AKBAR, WHERE HAVE YOU ALL GONE?\nPLEASE SAVE MY BABA FROM THESE EVIL ONES!'

arabic text:
JAB CHALEE GHAR SAY TERAY SAATH SABEEN THAY
ZAINAB
AUNO MUHAMMADO AKBAR YAAD ATAY HONGAY
LAUT KAY ATEE JO HOGEE TU ABHEE KHAANO SAY
english translation text: O ZAINAB, WHEN YOU LEFT MADINA EVERYONE WAS WITH YOU,\nYOU MUST BE REMEMBERING AUN AND MUHAMMAD & AKBAR\nNOW THAT YOU HAVE RETURNED TO YOUR HOUSE ALONE

arabic text: LABAI DERYA SAI ALAMDAR KI AAYI YEH SADA\nAI SAKINA TUJ SAI SHARMINDA HAI CHA CHA TERA\nPAANI PHONCHA NA SAKA HAI KATAI SHANO SAI
english translation text: THE VOICE OF HAZRAT ABBAS WAS HEARD FROM THE RIVER BANK,\n'O SAKINA, YOUR UNCLE CANNOT FACE YOU,\nI WAS UNABLE TO BRING WATER TO YOU WITH THESE SEVERED ARMS'

arabic text: AJ ADHAN PAY AIK WAQT FAZA MAIN GOONJI\nSANI-E-ZEHRA KAI KHUTBON KO DABANAY KAI LIYAI\nSHOR BERPA KIYA DERBA MAIN ADHANO SAI
english translation text: IN THE COURT OF YAZID IT WAS ORDERED THAT THE ADHAN WAS CALLED OUT TO DROWN OUT THE SERMONS OF ZAINAB (S),
